name: extract-around
description:
The part of the phrase before or after the first or the last occurrence of a text. Remove and extract only.

pattern: the text as typed, found anywhere, also inside a word («в» is found in «диван»); not a regular expression.
after: the part after the occurrence; by default the part before it.
last: the last occurrence; by default the first.
include: the occurrence itself belongs to the part.

remove finds the first occurrence in any case and the last one in the case written; extract matches the case written; ё = е. A phrase without the text has no part: remove leaves it, extract gives an empty cell.

extract-around keeps only what the matcher finds in the working column; an empty cell where it finds nothing.

Example: semkit read core.csv extract-around ' в ' --after --include write out.csv

options.name: --pattern
options.description: the text as typed, found anywhere, also inside a word («в» is found in «диван»); not a regular expression.

options.name: --after
options.description: the part after the occurrence; by default the part before it.

options.name: --include
options.description: the occurrence itself belongs to the part.

options.name: --last
options.description: the last occurrence; by default the first.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: PATTERN
arguments.description: the text as typed, found anywhere, also inside a word («в» is found in «диван»); not a regular expression. The same as --pattern PATTERN.
